launch_server: launch a SGLang inference server with specified model, port, and server arguments
test_health_generate: test the health of the SGLang inference server by checking /health endpoint
create_generate_request: create a text generation request via the native /generate endpoint with sampling parameters
create_chat_completions: create an OpenAI-compatible chat completion request via /v1/chat/completions endpoint
create_completions: create an OpenAI-compatible text completion request via /v1/completions endpoint
